MaterialCities is a dataset of the gross floor area and the mass of eight construction materials of the world’s buildings in high resolution and detail. It differentiates floor area (GFA) and material stocks (MS) by three building functions and five load-bearing structural types with region-specific construction archetypes using variant material intensity ranges that capture buildings materials’ inherent uncertainties and variabilities.
